entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [GeneratedComInterface] Generates ambiguous ABI_ overloads when interface methods differ only in parameter types #120410
  • Startup time of small workloads #120407
  • 1000 more types loaded in .NET 10 vs. .NET 8 during startup in a small workload #120406
  • R2R code missing for static interface methods #120405
  • Trimmer doesn't keep `TypeMapAssemblyTargetAttribute`s #120394

Closed

  • .NET needs something between InvariantGlobalization and setting CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture #120255
    Future
  • Expose MemberwiseClone on ValueType #18494
  • Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Binder crashes when binding to dynamic dictionary value #49929
    Future
  • [LibraryImport] Emits partially-qualified CharSet type which fails to compile if there is a "System" namespace nearby #120398
  • [8.0] Test assert failure in Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Binder.Tests.ConfigurationBinderTests.BindCanReadStaticProperty #107413
    8.0.x

PullRequests

Created

  • Support dynamically creating tailored continuation layouts #120411
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Remove unsafe `bool` casts #120400
    area-System.Numerics, community-contribution

    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr

    Servicing-approved
  • [release/9.0-staging] [mono][hotreload] Make the runtime ignore an update if it is an empty one #120335
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/10.0] [mono][hotreload] Make the runtime ignore an update if it is an empty one. #120334
    Servicing-approved
